Genes with well-known patterns of variation between populations

Source: R/data.R
teaching_genes.Rd

A curated set of genes that make good teaching examples, from genes under strong selection in particular populations (e.g. LCT, SLC24A5, ACKR1) to genes with more ordinary patterns of variation (CYP1A2, HTT). Any of them can be passed to fetch_region() by name.

Usage

teaching_genes

Format

A tibble with one row per gene:

gene

Gene symbol.

chrom, gene_start, gene_end, strand

Gene position on GRCh38.

region_start, region_end

The region fetched by default: the gene plus 25 kb on each side, which includes nearby regulatory variants.

description

A short, neutral description of what the gene does.

staff_notes

The expected pattern of variation and its explanation, for teaching staff.

Source

Gene positions from Ensembl (GRCh38). Built by data-raw/teaching_genes.R.

See also

teaching_snps for the key SNPs in each gene.
